title: Beyond Asking: A Pipeline for Personalized Game Generation that Reads Players from Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2608.16196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized game generation requires inferring a player's abilities and behavioral style from how they play. Large language models have made this inference more attainable than ever: an LLM can read a raw gameplay transcript and produce a fluent, plausible profile of the player. Plausible, however, is not verified, and verification is precisely what the field lacks: latent traits are unobservable; questionnaires provide noisy proxies and become circular when self-reports are used to validate behavior-based inference; and behavior itself is ambiguous without context -- a player who never collects an item may not want it, or may never have had the chance. We address both problems. First, we construct a synthetic player population whose traits are ground truth by construction: each trait is an explicit bot parameter, accepted only after controlled manipulation produces consistent, trait-specific behavioral change. translated_title: 超越提问：一种从行为读取玩家并生成个性化游戏的流水线
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16196v1 公告类型：新  摘要：个性化游戏生成需要从玩家的游戏方式中推断其能力和行为风格。大型语言模型使这种推断比以往任何时候都更易实现：一个LLM可以读取原始游戏记录并生成流畅、合理的玩家画像。然而，“合理”不等于“经过验证”，而验证正是该领域所缺乏的：潜在特质不可观测；问卷提供有噪声的代理指标，当用自我报告来验证基于行为的推断时会陷入循环；行为本身在缺乏上下文时具有歧义——一个从不收集物品的玩家可能不想要它，或者可能从未有机会获得它。我们解决了这两个问题。首先，我们构建了一个合成玩家群体，其特质通过构造即为地面真值：每个特质都是一个显式的机器人参数，仅在受控操作产生一致、特质特定的行为变化后才被接受。与先前的参数回归不同...
tldr: 本文提出了一种合成玩家群体构建方法，将机器人参数作为可验证的地面真值特质，并开发了一个流水线，使大语言模型能够从游戏行为中读取玩家并生成个性化游戏，解决了行为推断缺乏验证和上下文歧义的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a pipeline that constructs a synthetic player population with verifiable ground-truth traits as bot parameters, enabling LLMs to read player behavior and generate personalized games, addressing the lack of verification and contextual ambiguity in behavior-based inference.
